research.dailySignal: 今日共筛选出5篇达到阈值的研究，重点涉及妊娠合并母体睡眠呼吸障碍的胎儿和新生儿结局：一项系统综述、机器人辅助活体供者子宫切除术用于子宫移植：手术技术、供者安全与受者结局的系统综述、CDS2通过PI3K/AKT通路驱动上皮性卵巢癌肿瘤进展。以下内容用于研究情报追踪，单篇论文结论不等同于指南建议。

papers.title: Fetal and neonatal outcomes of pregnancies complicated by maternal sleep-disordered breathing: a systematic review.
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Maternal obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and the broader spectrum of sleep-disordered breathing (SDB) during pregnancy may be associated with fetal and neonatal outcomes, but the literature is heterogeneous and uses clinically distinct exposure definitions. This systematic review aimed to evaluate associations between maternal SDB and fetal/neonatal outcomes while preserving differences in exposure ascertainment.
METHODS: Following PRISMA 2020, the review was re-audited using updated PubMed and Web of Science searches, backward and forward citation searching, and ClinicalTrials.gov and WHO ICTRP registry searches. Exposures were classified as (1) objectively confirmed OSA/SDB, (2) administrative-code-defined OSA, and (3) symptom-, snoring-, or questionnaire-defined SDB risk. No meta-analysis was conducted because clinically comparable subsets were insufficient for quantitative pooling.
RESULTS: The completed re-audit identified 64 eligible publications mapped to 53 conservative cohort/dataset families (55 if two probable overlap pairs are treated as separate): 22 objective/physiologic, 11 administrative/clinical, and 31 symptom/questionnaire publications. Objective studies showed mixed findings, with fetal-growth or neonatal signals in selected cohorts but null findings in several other objectively assessed populations. Administrative-code OSA was repeatedly associated with preterm birth and selected neonatal outcomes, although exposure misclassification and residual confounding remain important. Symptom/questionnaire studies were heterogeneous, with associations varying by symptom definition, timing, and outcome.
CONCLUSION: Current evidence does not establish a consistent fetal or neonatal risk pattern for objectively confirmed maternal OSA/SDB. Administrative-code and symptom/questionnaire evidence suggests associations for selected outcomes, particularly preterm birth, but should not be interpreted as a single homogeneous OSA effect.
SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/, identifier CRD420251110706.

summaryZh.titleZh: 妊娠合并母体睡眠呼吸障碍的胎儿和新生儿结局：一项系统综述
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估母体睡眠呼吸障碍（SDB）与胎儿/新生儿结局之间的关联，同时保留暴露判定方式的差异。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 系统综述；遵循PRISMA 2020，重新审核检索；未进行Meta分析。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 共纳入64篇符合条件的出版物，映射为53个保守的队列/数据集家族（若将两对可能重叠的文献视为独立，则为55个）：22篇客观/生理学判定、11篇行政/临床编码判定、31篇症状/问卷判定。
summaryZh.methods: 更新PubMed和Web of Science检索，并进行后向和前向引文检索，以及ClinicalTrials.gov和WHO ICTRP注册库检索；将暴露分为客观确认的OSA/SDB、行政编码定义的OSA、症状/打鼾/问卷定义的SDB风险三类；因临床可比子集不足以定量合并，未进行Meta分析。
summaryZh.keyResults: 客观研究结果不一：部分队列显示胎儿生长或新生儿信号，但若干其他客观评估人群中为阴性。行政编码定义的OSA反复与早产及部分新生儿结局相关，但暴露错分和残余混杂仍重要。症状/问卷研究异质性大，关联随症状定义、时机和结局而变化。结论认为，现有证据未能在客观确认的母体OSA/SDB中建立一致的胎儿或新生儿风险模式；行政编码和症状/问卷证据提示部分结局（尤其早产）存在关联，但不应解释为单一同质的OSA效应。
summaryZh.limitations: 文献异质性强且暴露定义在临床上不同；因临床可比子集不足未进行Meta分析；行政编码暴露存在错分和残余混杂；症状/问卷研究异质性大。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 该综述提示，母体SDB与胎儿/新生儿结局的证据受暴露判定方式影响，不能将不同来源的证据视为单一同质的OSA效应；客观确认的OSA/SDB尚无一致的胎儿或新生儿风险模式。

papers.title: Robotic-assisted living-donor hysterectomy for uterus transplantation: a systematic review of surgical techniques, donor safety, and recipient outcomes.
papers.abstract: Uterus transplantation (UTx) has emerged as a promising treatment for women with absolute uterine factor infertility (AUFI), enabling pregnancy and live birth with their own genetic offspring. Living-donor uterus procurement remains the most technically demanding component of the procedure. Robotic-assisted donor hysterectomy has been introduced to improve surgical precision, reduce donor morbidity, and preserve graft quality, while recipient implantation is performed via laparotomy. This systematic review evaluated current evidence on robotic-assisted living-donor hysterectomy for UTx, focusing on surgical techniques, donor safety, recipient outcomes, and reproductive success. Databases and trial registries were searched from inception through June 2026. Six studies reporting 29 unique robotic-assisted living-donor hysterectomies across five countries met the inclusion criteria. All procedures used the da Vinci Xi robotic platform. Operative time and estimated blood loss decreased with increasing surgical experience, while major donor complications (Clavien-Dindo grade III or higher) were less frequent in later series. Among cases with reported follow-up, no graft loss was observed; restoration of menstruation, embryo transfer, clinical pregnancy, and live birth were achieved, including ten live births in the largest programme. Robotic-assisted living-donor hysterectomy for uterus transplantation appears technically feasible and has been associated with viable grafts and successful pregnancies in highly selected cases. However, major donor complications, including ureteric injury requiring reimplantation and bilateral oophorectomy, were observed, and the true incidence of donor morbidity remains uncertain. Current evidence remains limited to small observational studies, and these findings support careful evaluation within structured, multidisciplinary programmes and international registries rather than widespread expansion.

summaryZh.titleZh: 机器人辅助活体供者子宫切除术用于子宫移植：手术技术、供者安全与受者结局的系统综述
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估机器人辅助活体供者子宫切除术用于子宫移植的现有证据，重点关注手术技术、供者安全、受者结局和生殖成功。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 系统综述；检索数据库和试验注册库，检索时间自建库至2026年6月。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 6项研究，共29例独特的机器人辅助活体供者子宫切除术，分布于5个国家。
summaryZh.methods: 系统检索数据库和试验注册库；所有手术均使用da Vinci Xi机器人平台；供者子宫切除为机器人辅助，受者植入经剖腹术完成；评估手术技术、供者安全、受者结局和生殖成功。
summaryZh.keyResults: 随着手术经验增加，手术时间和估计失血量下降；主要供者并发症（Clavien-Dindo III级或以上）在较晚系列中较少见。在报告随访的病例中未观察到移植物丢失；实现了月经恢复、胚胎移植、临床妊娠和活产，其中最大项目报告10例活产。同时观察到主要供者并发症，包括需再植入的输尿管损伤和双侧卵巢切除；供者并发症的真实发生率仍不确定。
summaryZh.limitations: 现有证据仅限于小型观察性研究；供者并发症的真实发生率仍不确定；病例高度选择。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 作者认为，机器人辅助活体供者子宫切除术在高度选择的病例中技术上可行，并与有活力的移植物和成功妊娠相关；但鉴于观察到主要供者并发症且证据有限，应在结构化多学科项目和国际注册体系内谨慎评估，而非广泛推广。

papers.title: CDS2 Drives Tumor Progression in Epithelial Ovarian Cancer via the PI3K/AKT Pathway.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) frequently disseminates within the lipid-rich peritoneal cavity, where tumor progression is accompanied by metabolic adaptations involving lipid utilization and mitochondrial function. Although these metabolic alterations are increasingly recognized as important features of EOC progression and peritoneal metastasis, the molecular factors linking mitochondrial-lipid metabolic remodeling with aggressive tumor behavior remain incompletely characterized. We therefore integrated mitochondrial- and lipid metabolism-related transcriptomic analyses to identify candidate regulators and further investigated the clinical and biological features associated with CDS2.
RESULTS: Seven key genes associated with mitochondrial and lipid metabolism were identified in EOC through comprehensive bioinformatic analyses and were used to construct the MALRS prognostic model. Further integration of FIGO stage, histologic grade, and MALRS scores yielded a nomogram whose calibration plots showed good agreement between predicted and observed 1-, 3-, and 5-year survival probabilities. Subsequent screening of these candidate genes in chemotherapy-resistant datasets identified CDP-diacylglycerol synthase 2 (CDS2) as the most consistently upregulated candidate gene. Clinical validation confirmed that CDS2 was significantly overexpressed in tumor tissues and was associated with advanced disease stage, and survival analysis showed that higher CDS2 expression was associated with shorter progression-free survival (PFS) in stage III/IV patients. Functional characterization demonstrated that CDS2 overexpression promoted both lipid droplet accumulation and migratory capacity in ovarian cancer cells. Pathway analysis identified significant enrichment of PI3K/AKT signaling, and experimental validation confirmed CDS2-mediated hyperactivation of PI3K/AKT phosphorylation. Computational immune-deconvolution analyses further identified exploratory associations between CDS2 expression, estimated T-cell abundance, and immune-checkpoint transcripts.
CONCLUSION: CDS2 is a lipid metabolism-associated candidate biomarker linked to aggressive clinicopathological features in EOC. Our findings associate CDS2 with disease progression, PI3K/AKT-related signaling, and immune-related transcriptomic features, supporting its further evaluation as a candidate prognostic marker.

summaryZh.titleZh: CDS2通过PI3K/AKT通路驱动上皮性卵巢癌肿瘤进展
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 整合线粒体和脂质代谢相关转录组分析，识别上皮性卵巢癌（EOC）的候选调控因子，并研究CDS2相关的临床和生物学特征。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 生物信息学分析与实验验证研究（摘要未明确命名具体研究设计）。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 摘要未报告具体临床样本量；研究涉及EOC转录组数据、化疗耐药数据集、肿瘤组织临床验证及卵巢癌细胞功能实验。
summaryZh.methods: 整合线粒体和脂质代谢相关转录组分析；构建MALRS预后模型；结合FIGO分期、组织学分级和MALRS评分构建列线图并评估校准；在化疗耐药数据集中筛选候选基因；验证CDS2表达及其与分期和生存的关系；进行CDS2过表达的功能实验、PI3K/AKT通路分析和免疫去卷积分析。
summaryZh.keyResults: 识别出7个与线粒体和脂质代谢相关的关键基因，并用于构建MALRS预后模型；列线图校准图显示预测与观察的1年、3年和5年生存概率具有良好一致性。CDS2在化疗耐药数据集中是最持续上调的候选基因；临床验证显示CDS2在肿瘤组织中显著过表达，并与晚期疾病阶段相关；生存分析显示，在III/IV期患者中，CDS2表达较高与无进展生存期（PFS）较短相关。CDS2过表达促进卵巢癌细胞脂滴积累和迁移能力；通路分析显示PI3K/AKT信号显著富集，实验验证确认CDS2介导PI3K/AKT磷酸化过度激活；免疫去卷积分析发现CDS2表达、估计T细胞丰度和免疫检查点转录本之间存在探索性关联。
summaryZh.limitations: 摘要未报告研究局限性；免疫相关分析为探索性；具体样本量及验证队列信息未报告。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: CDS2是被关联到EOC侵袭性临床病理特征的脂质代谢相关候选生物标志物；研究结果将CDS2与疾病进展、PI3K/AKT相关信号及免疫相关转录组特征相联系，支持将其作为候选预后标志物进一步评估，但不等同于因果结论。

papers.title: Combined albumin-adjusted ischemia-modified albumin ratio and uterine artery Doppler for differentiating early-onset preeclampsia from gestational hypertension: a prospective exploratory pilot study.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Distinguishing early-onset preeclampsia (EO-PE) from gestational hypertension (GHT) at initial presentation remains challenging, particularly when classical diagnostic features are absent or evolving. We evaluated whether combining the albumin-adjusted ischemia-modified albumin ratio (IMAR) with uterine artery pulsatility index expressed as multiples of the median (UtA-PI MoM) provides complementary information in this setting.
METHODS: In this prospective single-center exploratory study, 90 singleton pregnancies (30 EO-PE, 30 GHT, 30 controls) were included. IMAR and UtA-PI MoM were assessed individually and in combination using receiver operating characteristic analysis and logistic regression with bootstrap internal validation.
RESULTS: IMAR and UtA-PI MoM were higher in EO-PE than in GHT (p = 0.003 and p < 0.001, respectively), whereas raw IMA did not distinguish the groups. IMAR demonstrated moderate discrimination (AUC 0.727, 95% CI 0.600-0.854), and UtA-PI MoM demonstrated higher performance (AUC 0.844, 95% CI 0.743-0.946). The combined model showed the highest apparent discrimination (AUC 0.898, 95% CI 0.818-0.977; optimism-corrected AUC 0.889), with 83.3% sensitivity and 86.7% specificity at the exploratory operating point.
CONCLUSIONS: Combining IMAR with UtA-PI MoM may provide complementary information for distinguishing EO-PE from GHT at initial presentation. This exploratory model is not intended to replace established angiogenic biomarkers and requires validation in larger, multicenter studies before clinical application.

summaryZh.titleZh: 白蛋白校正缺血修饰白蛋白比值联合子宫动脉多普勒鉴别早发型子痫前期与妊娠期高血压：一项前瞻性探索性预试验
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估白蛋白校正缺血修饰白蛋白比值（IMAR）联合子宫动脉搏动指数中位数倍数（UtA-PI MoM）是否能在初次就诊时为鉴别早发型子痫前期（EO-PE）与妊娠期高血压（GHT）提供互补信息。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 前瞻性单中心探索性预试验。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 90例单胎妊娠，包括30例EO-PE、30例GHT和30例对照。
summaryZh.methods: 检测IMAR和UtA-PI MoM，分别及联合使用受试者工作特征曲线分析和逻辑回归，并进行bootstrap内部验证。
summaryZh.keyResults: IMAR和UtA-PI MoM在EO-PE中高于GHT（分别为p=0.003和p<0.001），而原始IMA未能区分两组。IMAR具有中等区分度（AUC 0.727，95% CI 0.600-0.854）；UtA-PI MoM表现更高（AUC 0.844，95% CI 0.743-0.946）。联合模型显示最高表观区分度（AUC 0.898，95% CI 0.818-0.977；乐观校正后AUC 0.889），在探索性操作点下敏感度为83.3%、特异度为86.7%。
summaryZh.limitations: 单中心探索性预试验；样本量为90例；需在更大规模多中心研究中验证；该探索性模型不旨在替代已建立的血管生成生物标志物。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 在初次就诊时，IMAR联合UtA-PI MoM可能为鉴别EO-PE与GHT提供互补信息；但该模型仍属探索性，在临床 application 前需要更大规模多中心验证。

papers.title: Re-irradiation with image-guided radiotherapy for recurrent cervical cancer: an analysis of outcomes and toxicity.
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Recurrent cervical cancer within previously irradiated fields remains a major therapeutic challenge. This study aimed to evaluate clinical outcomes and safety of image-guided re-irradiation and to identify prognostic factors associated with tumor control and treatment-related toxicity.
METHODS: All consecutive patients who underwent image-guided re-irradiation between March 2020 and December 2024 were retrospectively analyzed. Re-irradiation was delivered using image-guided external beam radiotherapy and/or image-guided brachytherapy. Concurrent chemotherapy or immunotherapy was administered when clinically indicated. Organ at risk doses were recorded from re-irradiation plans. Logistic models were applied to evaluate tumor control probability and normal tissue complication probability.
RESULTS: A total of 102 patients were included. At recurrence, 45.1% had central relapse, 14.7% pelvic relapse, 17.6% combined central and pelvic relapse, and 22.5% had distant metastasis. The median re-irradiation dose was 56.8 Gy (a/β = 10). With a median follow-up of 13.7 months, the 1- and 2-year LC were 67.6% and 59.2%, and the 1- and 2-year PFS were 52.7% and 42.6%. Higher re-irradiation prescription EQD2 was associated with improved tumor control. A progression-free interval > 2 years after initial radiotherapy predicted better progression-free survival and local control, whereas distant metastasis was associated with inferior progression-free survival. Higher rectal and bladder D2cc values were significantly associated with increased late toxicity. The risk of grade ≥ 2 late complications rose substantially when the rectal or bladder D2cc exceeded approximately 50 Gy (a/β = 3). No grade 4 or 5 toxicities were observed in this study.
CONCLUSION: Re-irradiation is a feasible and effective salvage option for patients with recurrent cervical cancer and provides moderate local control with acceptable toxicity.

summaryZh.titleZh: 图像引导放疗再程放疗治疗复发性宫颈癌：结局与毒性分析
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估图像引导再程放疗治疗复发性宫颈癌的临床结局和安全性，并识别与肿瘤控制和治疗相关毒性相关的预后因素。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 回顾性分析，连续纳入2020年3月至2024年12月接受图像引导再程放疗的患者。
summaryZh.methods: 再程放疗采用图像引导外照射放疗和/或图像引导近距离放疗；临床需要时给予同步化疗或免疫治疗；记录再程放疗计划中的危及器官剂量；应用逻辑模型评估肿瘤控制概率和正常组织并发症概率。
summaryZh.keyResults: 复发时45.1%为中央型复发，14.7%为盆腔复发，17.6%为中央和盆腔合并复发，22.5%有远处转移。再程放疗中位剂量为56.8 Gy（a/β=10）。中位随访13.7个月，1年和2年局部控制率分别为67.6%和59.2%，1年和2年无进展生存率分别为52.7%和42.6%。较高的再程放疗处方EQD2与更好的肿瘤控制相关。初次放疗后无进展间期>2年预测更好的无进展生存和局部控制，而远处转移与较差的无进展生存相关。较高的直肠和膀胱D2cc值与晚期毒性增加显著相关；当直肠或膀胱D2cc超过约50 Gy（a/β=3）时，≥2级晚期并发症风险显著升高。本研究未观察到4级或5级毒性。
summaryZh.limitations: 回顾性分析；中位随访13.7个月；摘要未报告其他局限性。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 在该队列中，再程放疗是复发性宫颈癌可行的挽救治疗选择，并提供了中等程度的局部控制和可接受的毒性；较高的再程放疗剂量与更好的肿瘤控制相关，而直肠和膀胱D2cc较高与晚期毒性风险增加相关。
